description: Witness conditions see original words and their own constructed omissions (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:candidate %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(rival)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule rival ($y:X [+T]) %conditions $.source-text = "x", $.value = "x", $y.tags = X, $y.starts-input, $ ≅ #« X T="" »
